attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the epithet is the same in both: «ο Θαυμαστορείτης», the man of the Wonderful Mountain, which is what the corpus's display name says in English. Nothing in the folder's existing `dates` is touched.
